picks.title: Bishop and Stake President Conflict After a Mormon Faith Crisis - Coy Johnston | Ep. 2182
picks.summary: Today we sit down with Coy Johnston, a longtime active member of the LDS Church, to explore what it looks like to question Mormonism without completely walking away.Coy grew up in Mesa, Arizona, served a mission in England, became a doctor, and spent his life deeply involved in the church. His faith began to shift as he studied scripture and biblical scholarship, and issues with early Mormon church history. He shares how learning more about church history changed his understanding of Mormonism and led him into a faith crisis that affected his family, callings, and relationship with church lead
picks.reason: A Mormon's nuanced faith crisis and evolving understanding of church history and belief.

picks.reason: A gay Mormon shares his struggle with faith and identity within his religion.

picks.title: You Are Invited - Religion to Redemption - Matthew S6E3
picks.summary:
What happens when religion gets in the way of redemption?
 In Matthew 21:23–22:14, Jesus confronts the religious leaders through three powerful parables that expose the difference between simply looking religious and truly surrendering to Him. We see that salvation cannot be earned through good works or religious activity. 
The invitation to the Kingdom is extended to everyone, but we must respond with repentance, faith, and surrender to Jesus.

picks.title: Episode 386: Raised in the Woods, Survived a Serial Killer & Finding Hope | feat. Kelsey Vandermyde
picks.summary: This week we sit down with Kelsey, who grew up deep in the mountains of Montana with no electricity, no running water, and a father convinced the world was ending. From polygamy and mountain lions to a serial killer staying in their cabin, Kelsey's story is one of the wildest you'll ever hear. JP and the crew don't see eye to eye with Kelsey on everything when it comes to faith — but that's exactly what makes this conversation worth having. Come for the crazy story, stay for the honest and gracious dialogue!
picks.reason: A personal story of survival and faith amid hardship and doubt.

picks.title: Should Christians PRAY to Saints!? (Pastors REACT To Viral Video) | Live Free with Josh Howerton
picks.summary:
In Episode 90 of the LIVE FREE Podcast, Pastors Josh Howerton, Carlos Erazo, and Paul Cunningham uncover surprising lessons hidden inside some of the Bible passages we usually skim—including the stories of Mark, Demas, Rufus, and Quartus. Their lives reveal powerful truths about failure, restoration, friendship, legacy, and lifelong faithfulness.

The conversation also gets intensely practical: Who are the people carrying your mat when you're struggling? Is it biblical to pray for God's judgment on someone? And why does Scripture teach that Christians can approach God directly through Jesus?
picks.reason: Biblical stories reveal faith and restoration but focus is practical and pastoral.
